# Polaris demo template

Place your demo under `docs/<DemoName>/` with:
- `Intelligence Hub.html` (hub page linking every screen)
- Other pages (`Theater Map.html`, `Adversary Posture.html`, etc.)
- `index.html` = redirect to `Intelligence Hub.html` (use the provided template)

GitHub Pages settings:
- Source: Deploy from a branch
- Branch: `main`, Folder: `/docs`
